title: Normalize Process Plugin Crate To Consistency Contract
description: Normalize process/plugin/rs/lib.rs (Process3dPlayApp) to the wave-4 Consistency Contract: adopt SDK PanelKit (tree_item_with_action/tree_item_desc/PanelTreeBuilder) for build_document_tree/build_catalogue_tree, adopt SDK Terminology (app_labels!/LocaleLabels/resolve_labels/localized_label_map/AppLabelsOverlayExt) replacing the hand-rolled Process3dLabels struct+consts+resolver and the hand-rolled action/utility label-map functions, adopt SDK Testkit (testkit::meta/new_app/assert_undo_redo_round_trip) replacing local meta()/new_app() test scaffolding, unwrap the incorrectly-nested `pub mod app_3d { ... }` to a flat single-app crate layout (C4), rename the "🔖️Bundle" region into a single "🔖️Manifest" region (C2) and add a "🧪️Tests" region marker (C3), and reorder regions into canonical order where practical. C1 app-struct naming (Process3dPlayApp) is already compliant; verify only.
summary:
Normalized process/plugin/rs/lib.rs (Process3dPlayApp, app id "process3d-play") to the Consistency Contract. C1 naming was already compliant (Process3dPlayApp), verified only. C4: unwrapped the incorrectly-nested `pub mod app_3d { ... }` to a flat single-app layout (dedented, dropped the now-redundant module doc comment and the `pub` on Process3dPlayApp/create_process3d_app/register_process3d_exports, stripped `app_3d::` prefixes from the plugin macro call). C2/C3: merged the standalone "🔖️Bundle" region (the semio_plugin! macro call) into a single "🔖️Manifest" region, renamed "🔖️Document" to "🔖️DocumentHelpers", added a "🧪️Tests" region wrapping `mod tests`, and reordered top-level regions into canonical order (Constants -> DocumentHelpers -> KernelReplay -> MediaImportExport -> Terminology -> CommandLabels -> Panels -> Engagement -> Process3dPlayApp -> Manifest -> Tests). Adopted SDK PanelKit: deleted the local `tree_item_with_action` duplicate, rewrote build_document_tree/build_catalogue_tree on `PanelTreeBuilder` + the SDK's `tree_item_with_action`/`tree_item_desc` (kept a tiny app-specific `iconed_tree_item_with_action` wrapper since the SDK helper has no icon slot). Adopted SDK Terminology: replaced the hand-rolled `Process3dLabels` struct + EN/DE consts + resolver function with `app_labels!`/`LocaleLabels`/`resolve_labels`, replaced the two hand-rolled action/utility label-map functions with `localized_label_map` over plain entry-table consts, and rewrote `app_labels()` on `AppLabelsOverlay::default()` + `AppLabelsOverlayExt` fluent builder methods (window_kind_label/action_labels/utility_labels — confirmed no `.app_label()` method exists on the real overlay ext trait). Adopted SDK Testkit: removed the local `meta`/`new_app` scaffolding in favor of `semio_framework_plugin::testkit::{meta, new_app}` (kept a one-line `fn new_app() -> VcsDocumentApp<Process3dPlayApp>` wrapper around `testkit::new_app::<Process3dPlayApp>()`, matching the pattern already established in sibling crates e.g. sequence/plugin), and converted the one undo/redo test to `testkit::assert_undo_redo_round_trip` (this also added a redo assertion the original test lacked). C6: verified — Cargo.toml only depends on this app's own domain crate (process_3d) plus framework/kernel/vcs, no other app's plugin crate. Resource-kind: verified — `.resource_kind(ResourceKindSpec { id: "3d.process", ... })` was already present and correct from Wave 1, untouched. No convergence/idempotency tests existed in this crate so none were added (out of scope per the task's "leave app-unique tests untouched" instruction — only replaced scaffolding, not invented new coverage). Nothing needed flagging for the Wave-4 SDK-primitives audit — every mechanism this crate used (PanelKit, Terminology, Testkit) had a real, matching SDK primitive.

Verified: rustfmt --check (and then --write, matching the 0-diff convention already established by closed sibling tickets e.g. mathematical/sequence) passes clean, confirming full syntactic validity via a real parse. Brace/paren balance confirmed equal pre/post edit (620/620, 1851/1851). Exhaustive grep cross-reference of every renamed/removed identifier (app_3d::, pub mod app_3d, ActionMeta, local meta()/new_app(), process3d_labels(), PROCESS3D_LABELS_NATIVE_EN/DE, local tree_item_with_action) confirmed zero residue. A bag-of-normalized-lines diff between the pre-edit snapshot and the final file confirmed every line removed was an intentional part of the refactor (old struct/const/fn bodies, old imports before rustfmt reflow, mod-wrapper boilerplate) and every line added was an intentional part of the refactor (macro/builder-based replacements) — no accidental business-logic loss. Skipped: a full `cargo check -p process-plugin --tests` — the repo has 100+ concurrent cargo processes from other sessions contending for the shared build lock (confirmed via `ps aux`, matching the known issue called out in CLAUDE.md); the invocation sat on "Blocking waiting for file lock" with zero progress past ~3 minutes, so per the verification policy I moved to the static checks above instead of blocking further. The orchestrator's final full `cargo check --workspace` gate will confirm the compile.
